davomat.settings.description: Your organization, who signs in, the Telegram bot and the attendance rules.
davomat.settings.organization.descriptio: The name, logo, time zone and language everyone sees.
davomat.settings.users.description: Who signs in to this app, with which role and for which locations.
davomat.settings.telegram.description: Your organization’s own bot: arrivals, lateness and daily summaries in Telegram.
davomat.settings.account.description: Your sign-in, your password, your language and how the app looks for you.
davomat.settings.panel.attendance.descri: Grace periods, reminders, early leaving and what needs a manager’s approval.
davomat.settings.faceid.title: Face ID
davomat.settings.faceid.hint: What a scan sets off, Telegram posts and how long snapshots are kept.
davomat.settings.empty.title: Nothing to set up here
davomat.settings.empty.body: Your role doesn’t include settings. An administrator can change them.
davomat.settings.readOnly.title: You can look, not change
davomat.settings.readOnly.body: Changing these settings needs an administrator.
davomat.org.identityHint: Shown on the sign-in page, in the sidebar, on reports and in Telegram messages.
davomat.org.logoHint: A square image looks best: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
davomat.org.logoType: Use a PNG, JPG or WebP image.
davomat.org.logoTooBig: The image is too big: up to 5 MB.
davomat.org.name: Organization name
davomat.org.nameHint: The full name, as your people know it.
davomat.org.productNameHint: What the sign-in page, the browser tab and Telegram messages call this app.
davomat.org.regionHint: Arrivals, lateness and reports follow this clock; Telegram messages use this language.
davomat.org.timezoneHint: It decides where each day starts. Past records keep their times.
davomat.org.languageHint: For Telegram messages and new users. Everyone can pick their own.
davomat.org.terminalsHint: What happens when a terminal sees a face nobody here is linked to.
davomat.org.autoCreateHint: A number the terminal knows becomes a new employee, named as on the terminal. You only fix names and positions.
davomat.users.filter.label: Show
davomat.users.col.name: Name
davomat.users.telegramYes: Telegram linked: gets the bot’s messages
davomat.users.empty.title: Only you so far
davomat.users.empty.body: Add the people who look after attendance: administrators, location managers, or viewers who only read.
davomat.users.actions.label: Actions for {name}
davomat.users.deactivate.title: Deactivate {name}?
davomat.users.deactivate.body: They can’t sign in any more and the bot stops writing to them. Their history stays, and you can bring them back at any time.
davomat.users.telegramHint: Scan the code with their phone, or send them the link. It works once, for 24 hours.
davomat.users.createHint: They sign in to this app with the username and password you set here.
davomat.users.fromEmployeeHint: Give someone who scans at the terminals a sign-in too, with the same name and history.
davomat.users.usernameHint: What they type to sign in: letters, digits and . _ -
davomat.users.passwordHint: Give it to them in person. They can change it in their account.
davomat.users.branchesHint: They see only these locations’ people, scans and reports.
davomat.users.ownerLocked: The owner’s role and access don’t change here.
davomat.users.selfLocked: You can’t change your own role or locations. Another administrator can.
davomat.users.details.title: User created
davomat.users.details.once: The password isn’t shown again. If it gets lost, set a new one from the user’s menu.
davomat.users.password.title: New password for {name}
davomat.users.password.hint: The old password stops working at once, and they are signed out everywhere.
davomat.users.password.doneHint: Tell {name} the new password. It works right away.
davomat.users.guide.title: What each role can do
davomat.users.guide.hint: Employees who only scan at the terminals don’t need a user.
davomat.users.role.owner.name: Owner
davomat.users.role.owner.can1: Everything in the app, at every location
davomat.users.role.owner.can2: Users, roles and the Telegram bot
davomat.users.role.owner.can3: Can’t be switched off by anyone
davomat.users.role.admin.name: Administrator
davomat.users.role.admin.hint: Everything at every location, including users and settings.
davomat.users.role.admin.can2: Adds users and sets their passwords
davomat.users.role.manager.name: Manager
davomat.users.role.manager.hint: Attendance and the team of the locations you choose.
davomat.users.role.manager.can1: Attendance and the team of their locations
davomat.users.role.viewer.name: Viewer
davomat.users.role.viewer.hint: Reads the live board, attendance and reports of their locations, and changes nothing.
davomat.users.role.viewer.can1: The live board of their locations
davomat.users.role.viewer.can2: Attendance, timesheets and reports, to read
davomat.users.role.other.hint: A role made for this organization.
davomat.telegram.status.notSet.title: No bot connected yet
davomat.telegram.status.notSet.body: Connect your organization’s own Telegram bot. Arrivals with the photo, lateness and the daily summary go out through it.
davomat.telegram.status.ok.title: Bot connected
davomat.telegram.status.ok.body: The bot sends your organization’s messages to everyone who linked their Telegram.
davomat.telegram.status.invalid.title: The bot stopped working
davomat.telegram.status.invalid.body: Telegram no longer accepts this token; it was probably replaced in @BotFather. Paste the new one below.
davomat.telegram.readOnly: Connecting the bot needs an administrator.
davomat.telegram.token.title: Paste the token
davomat.telegram.token.hint: We check it with Telegram before saving.
davomat.telegram.token.label: Bot token
davomat.telegram.token.secret: Stored encrypted. Nobody can read it back, not even administrators.
davomat.telegram.token.format: That doesn’t look like a bot token. Copy it again from @BotFather.
davomat.telegram.disconnect.title: Disconnect the bot?
davomat.telegram.disconnect.body: The bot stops sending messages until you connect one again. Nothing else changes.
davomat.telegram.guide.title: Make a bot in two minutes
davomat.telegram.guide.hint: In Telegram, on any phone or computer.
davomat.telegram.guide.step1: Open @BotFather, Telegram’s official bot for making bots.
davomat.telegram.guide.step3: Choose the name people will see, for example your organization’s name.
davomat.telegram.guide.step4: Choose a username that ends in “bot”, for example:
davomat.telegram.guide.step5: BotFather answers with a token. Copy it and paste it here.
davomat.telegram.me.title: Your Telegram
davomat.telegram.me.linked: Linked. The bot writes to you: arrivals, lateness and the daily summary.
davomat.telegram.me.notLinked: Not linked yet. Scan a code with your phone to get the messages yourself.
davomat.telegram.me.dialogHint: Scan the code with your phone’s camera, or open the link on this device.
davomat.telegram.test.title: Send a test message
davomat.telegram.test.hint: The bot writes a short test message to your own Telegram.
davomat.telegram.test.notLinked: Link your own Telegram first: a bot can only write to people who started it.
davomat.telegram.test.failed: Couldn’t send the test. Try again in a minute.
davomat.telegram.sends.title: What the bot sends
davomat.telegram.sends.hint: Only to people who linked their Telegram, about the locations they see.
davomat.telegram.sends.arrivals: Arrivals with the photo from the terminal
davomat.telegram.sends.own: Each employee’s own arrival and departure
davomat.telegram.link.step1: Open the phone’s camera and point it at the code.
davomat.telegram.link.step2: Tap the link: Telegram opens the bot.
davomat.telegram.link.step3: Tap Start. The bot confirms the link.
davomat.telegram.link.expires: The link works for {time} more, once.
davomat.telegram.link.linkedBody: The bot writes to this person. Unlink to stop the messages.
davomat.telegram.link.noBotBody: Links are made by your organization’s bot. Add its token in Settings › Telegram.
davomat.account.password.title: Password
davomat.account.password.hint: At least 8 characters, not a common word and not only digits.
davomat.account.password.same: The new password is the same as the current one.
davomat.account.password.changedHint: Done. Your other browsers were signed out; use the new password there.
davomat.account.prefs.title: Language and appearance
davomat.account.prefs.hint: Only for you. The language follows your account; the appearance stays in this browser.
davomat.account.appearance.title: Appearance
